name: Chandra Prabhu International Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, Chandra Prabhu International Ltd trades in coal, metal and deals in agro sector[1]
keyPoints:
Business Verticals:[1][2][3]
a) Coal:
CPIL is in the business of coal trading. It has various branches in India including Bokaro, Chandasi, Kolkata & Gandhidham 
b) Agriculture:
The company does trading of agricultural commodities including Wheat, Rice, Spices, Sugarcane, Cereals & Pulses etc. It has revived /restarted its Agro Business with the use of new technology & Hi-tech agro machinery/equipment
c) Metal:
The company has entered into trading of new segment i.e. metal division
d) Infrastructure:
They have also entered into business of infrastructure projects

pros: Stock is trading at 0.60 times its book value
Company's median sales growth is 17.1% of last 10 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 8.10% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.7.76 Cr.
